headline: 2026-27 MLB free agent tracker: Pre-Thanksgiving frenzy finds new homes for Skubal, Rogers, Peralta, more
author: Kate Feldman

paragraphs.text: Where will the best players in free agency wind up? Follow along as we keep track of all the moves from an unusual offseason
Nov 28, 2026 at 2:51 pm ET • 1 min read

Tarik Skubal is going to be a New York Met. The two-time Cy Young winner is joining the Mets on a nine-year, $450 million contract that will keep him in Flushing through 2035. That contract breaks the record for both total value and AAV for a pitcher (excluding Shohei Ohtani).

A pre-Thanksgiving frenzy, meanwhile, landed starters Trevor Rogers and Hiromi Itoh, as well as NPB slugger Teruaki Sato, with the Cubs, ALCS MVP Freddy Peralta with the Orioles and Kaima Taira with the Blue Jays. And then on Friday, the Blue Jays followed that up by adding two-time All-Star Jazz Chisholm Jr.

Now, the rest of the free agent class, including solid options like Randy Arozarena, Seiya Suzuki and Luis Arraez, are racing against the clock before the expected lockout after the CBA expires at 11:59 p.m. on Dec. 1.
Where will everyone land? CBS Sports will be keeping track of the top 50 free agents below.
